title: Unconditional Repository/Database Queries inside Domain Entities
pattern: A domain entity directly invokes database repositories, query managers, or out-of-process services inside its business logic methods.
why_bad: It tightly couples the domain entity to persistence infrastructure. This prevents the entity from being tested hermetically in memory without mocking out databases, and hides the transactional and performance costs of business operations.
detection: Domain entities or aggregates that hold references to or import repository classes or query execution modules.
counterexample: Infrastructure adapter implementations designed specifically to bridge queries.
source: Vaughn Vernon, *Implementing Domain-Driven Design* (2013), Chapter 2, "Collaboration Context", p. 515.
